question.text: Let $a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots$ be a G.P. of increasing positive terms. If $a_1 a_5=28$ and $a_2+a_4=29$, then $a_6$ is equal to:

solution.text:
$\begin{aligned}
& a_1 a_5=28 \Rightarrow a^2 r^4=28 \\
& a_2+a_4=29 \Rightarrow a r+a r^3=29
\end{aligned}$
ar and $a r^3$ are roots of
$\begin{aligned}
& k^2-29 k+28=0 \\
& \Rightarrow \quad k=1, k=28 \\
& a r=1, a r^3=28 \\
& r^2=28, a^2=\frac{1}{28} \\
& a_6=a r^5 \Rightarrow r^4=28^2 \\
& \Rightarrow a_6=784
\end{aligned}$
